title: Leadership Development Skills
summary: A webinar on "Leadership Development Skills" is organized along with the 20th Anniversary celebration of IEEE Student Branch of University of Peradeniya, carried by Ms. Michelle Fernando, Superintendent OT Networks at BHP, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia.
